summary: Razorpay checkout integration project with UPI payment option fix needed for desktop version.
architectural_notes: Razorpay checkout must display UPI payment option on both desktop and mobile layouts.
known_issues: UPI payment option missing in desktop version of Razorpay checkout.

existing_features.title: Fix the Razorpay checkout configuration in `frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts` so that the UPI payment method is included and visible in the desktop checkout flow. The device-aware payment method configuration currently used in the hook must be updated to ensure UPI is not excluded or omitted when the device is detected as desktop. UPI should appear as a payment option on both mobile and desktop.
